testCorrections: Nine initial failures were obsolete fixed-title/CPU-concession expectations or a test-helper save timing assumption. The corrected 24-case run supersedes those cases; the runtime did not change between runs.
limitations: Rankings are local to this browser/origin, not shared over the LAN or internet.
Physical mobile devices, OS installation and speaker audition were not tested.
PWA installation still needs trusted HTTPS; current LAN HTTP is for browser play.
Existing 500-round resource and throttled performance measurements belong to prior builds and were not rerun.
